introHtml: Custom Tangle badge ID holders are designed to eliminate the frustration of twisted lanyards and tangled cords. Made from flexible, durable material, these holders keep ID badges accessible and secure throughout the workday. Ideal for busy environments like hospitals, warehouses, or corporate offices, they offer a practical upgrade over standard badge reels. Choose from multiple attachment options and imprint your logo in full color for a professional look that stands out.
heroAltText: Custom Tangle badge ID holders with printed logo, featuring tangle-free retractable cord and durable clip.
